erratum.chronology_classification: exploratory comparison and arithmetic gate evaluated on already-seen source outcomes; not independently time-certified and not externally preregistered

chep2026.final_return_weight_dependency: Source documentation does not establish independence from final returns

limitations: CHEP LIKELYVOTER nonvote is modeled, not observed completed abstention.
AP historical transfer is cross-sectional source transfer, not a matched panel.
AP poll-close weights are used for historical scoring; final-vote weights are not consumed.
AP2024 bridge weights used by older accepted work can depend on final returns; this ablation does not claim independent population validation.
CHEP source weights may depend on final returns; source holdout supports conditional testing only.
No product of marginal tables is treated as an observed transition.
Race and sex are not harmonized across AP studies.
No respondent vectors, estimators, source rows, state score tables, or private fine cells are exported.
The original frozen_at timestamp and prefit-freeze claim are withdrawn.
The age/education difference is exploratory, small, and lacks uncertainty analysis or a new independent historical episode.
AP and CHEP age/education blocks are thematic rather than identical specifications.
The arithmetic gate compares with prior_only, not the accepted full rich model, and does not justify promotion.
CHEP jurisdiction rows establish pooled source presence only, not state-inference qualification.

promotion_decision.ap_chep_spec_note: AP uses one prior; CHEP uses two priors. Age/education blocks are thematic comparisons, not identical specifications or a shared identified mechanism.
promotion_decision.arithmetic_rule: A common AP/CHEP block is a scientific follow-up candidate only if both weighted multiclass log loss and Brier improve strictly versus prior_only on both the AP2022-to-AP2024 transfer and the CHEP2026 respondent holdout.

query_definitions.calibration_rows: For each complete model table, one row per D/R/O/N/U category with raw outcome support, weighted observed share and weighted mean prediction. Entire table held if any class has fewer than 30 raw outcomes.
query_definitions.jurisdiction_rows: All 50 states plus DC. AP decisions identify the common 48-state transfer frame. CHEP decisions identify source presence and pooled holdout eligibility only; state-inference qualification is not claimed.
query_definitions.metric_rows: Twelve source evaluations: ten multinomial logistic estimator fits and two training-weighted marginal calculations. Numeric scores are unchanged.
